laws: Source and target packed coordinates have x in the upper half and y in the lower half, in eighth-pixel units. Only x=65535 marks an absent correspondence.

Estimation failure stores Q16 identity and returns zero; stationary success stores Q16 identity and returns one. Final grid validation failure returns zero without changing the fitted matrix. With consensus and refinement disabled the matrix remains unchanged.

Sparse confidence uses signed division truncating toward zero, then stores the low byte of agreeing*127/neighbors-128. Rounded coordinates use wrapping addition of four followed by logical shift by three.
Triangle coefficients use wrapping 32-bit determinants, signed 64-bit rounded division, Q14 support voting and first-winner ties. Linear output coefficients clamp to [-131071,131071].

Refinement products wrap to 32 bits before accumulation into unsigned 64-bit sums. Conversion to binary64 precedes non-fused ordered multiply/add/subtract and division. Float-to-signed32 truncates, saturates and maps NaN to zero.

Grid validation overwrites the first four workspace planes from packed coordinates selected by the low-byte register-shift mask at options+40. Residual absolute values retain signed32 overflow behavior; thresholds are options+41 and +42 multiplied by 65535, not 65536. Empty support accepts.
Only compiler arithmetic ABI helpers remain external. No application CPU body is forwarded to a stock address.
